reply: this is how the citizen militia works: when the defender has no troops left in that domain, a militia fights instead and kills a % of every unit you send (about 4-25% depending on their population and provinces). because it's a percentage, sending 1 troop or 100k loses about the same share, so send only what you need. refunds are a staff decision. if you think the militia hits too hard, post it in #suggestions and it goes on the next ballot
summary: Militia casualties are intended (% of units sent); balance complaint, pointed to suggestions. Refund request left to staff.
